content.doc_md:
## Tutorials

The Mid() function extracts some characters from a string (starting at any position).

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Mid("SQL Tutorial", 3) AS ExtractString;

---

Mid(
string
,
start
,
length
)

---

SELECT Mid(CustomerName, 4, 6) AS ExtractString
FROM Customers;
```

## Tutorials

The Replace() function replaces a substring within a string, with another 
substring, a specified number of times.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Replace("My name is Willy Wonka", "i", "a") AS ReplaceString;

---

Replace(
string1
,
find
,
replacement
,
start
,
count
,
compare
)
```

## Tutorials

The Right() function extracts a number of characters from a string (starting from 
right).

Note:See also theLeft()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 
  Right("SQL Tutorial is cool", 4) AS ExtractString;

---

Right(
string
,
number_of_chars
)

---

SELECT Right(CustomerName, 5) AS ExtractString
FROM Customers;
```

## Tutorials

The RTrim() function removes trailing spaces from a string.

Note:See also theLTrim()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 
  RTrim("SQL Tutorial    ") AS RightTrimmedString;

---

RTrim(
string
)
```

## Tutorials

The Space() function returns a string of the specified number of space characters.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 
  Space(5) AS SpaceString;

---

Space(
number
)
```
